title: Karpy event envelope v1
description: Every message published to the Karpy RabbitMQ events exchange is one JSON object of this shape. The routing key equals `type`. Consumers must ignore unknown top-level fields only if they are added in a later envelope version; within v1 additional properties are rejected.

id.description: Unique event id (UUID, v7 recommended so ids sort by time). Also sent as the AMQP message_id.

type.description: Event type and routing key: <domain>.<entity>.<event>, lowercase, past tense event, e.g. `content.post.published`.

version.description: Schema version of `data` for this event type. Bump on breaking change; publish both versions during migration.

source.description: Logical name of the producing service, e.g. `karpy` or `example-service`.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened (not when it was published), RFC 3339 UTC.

correlation_id.description: Id shared by every request and event in one business flow (usually the originating X-Request-Id).

causation_id.description: Id of the event or request that directly caused this event.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key consumers dedupe on. Same fact published twice => same key. Defaults to `id` when the producer has no better natural key.

traceparent.description: Optional W3C trace context of the producing span (also sent as an AMQP header).

data.description: Event payload; its schema is owned by the event type and version. Never put secrets or full personal records here - prefer references.
